Purchasing a playbook is step one; execution and scaling are where long-term business growth happens. If you want to maximize your investment in AI Automation Mastery™, follow this four-phase scaling roadmap over the next few months:

Phase 1: The Productivity Audit (Weeks 1-2)

Phase 2: Implementing Prompt Chains (Weeks 3-4)
